faq.a: Binti is associated with the Arabic form بِنْتِي, whose core sense is binti; my daughter (swahili form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Binti?
faq.a: Binti is associated with Arabic. Binti is the Swahili form of Arabic بِنْتِي (Bintī), meaning 'my daughter'.
Yes — the underlying form بِنْتِي is Arabic.
Binti can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Binti should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Bint is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Binti mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Binti is rendered بندی and carries the sense بندی، میری بیٹی.

faq.q: What does Binti mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Binti is rendered بندی and carries the sense بندی، دختر من.
A romanized syllable approximation is bin-ti. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Binti?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Binti, binti. Script forms are بندي, بندی, بِنْتِي, बिंती.

faq.q: Is Binti a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
